name: Gripping Strand
description: Cast a gripping strand over an opponent's soul so that its next movement drags.

name: Braided Guard
description: Braid three strands into a guard before the user that bears a soul-strike better than any one would.

name: Hauling Hitch
description: Hitch a strand to a far soul and haul the user across in one step.

name: Strand Gauge
description: Run a strand along a soul and gauge how much binding it will take.

name: Fastening Wrap
description: Wrap the opponent's soul in a fastening that holds the limbs of its intent and presses down its force.

name: Tangling Weft
description: Throw a tangling weft across a forming technique so that it fouls and fails.

name: Master Shackle
description: Close a master shackle on an opponent's soul so that it cannot gather force or move freely.

name: Shackle Crush
description: Crush the shackle inward on the held soul so that a heavy shock presses it down at once.

name: Patient Knot
description: Tie a patient knot on an opponent's soul and let it tighten one slow turn at a time.

name: Settling Knot
description: Let a knot settle before the user's chest so that it takes a soul-strike without giving way.

name: Creeping Slide
description: Slide the user's weight along a slack line to a new stance with no shift in the soul-field.

name: Knot Listening
description: Listen through a knot already tied and hear how the held soul's will is bending.

name: Deepening Knot
description: Let the knot sink deeper with each breath so that the held soul's force falls lower.

name: Breath Hasp
description: Close a hasp on the held soul's breath of force so that it cannot gather a new technique.

name: Patient Constriction
description: Draw every knot closed together over many breaths until the held soul can neither move nor cast.

name: Final Cinch
description: Pull the last knot shut with a single hard cinch that crushes the held soul's force.

name: Azure Strand
description: Throw a strand tinted pale blue round an opponent's soul and draw it snug.

name: Skylit Hitch
description: Hitch a bright strand to a high soul and swing across to it.

name: Bright Wrap
description: Wrap the user in bright cordage that dulls a soul-strike before it lands.

name: Cordage Touch
description: Touch a soul with a cord and learn how many bindings it already bears.

name: Cordage Weave
description: Weave cords round an opponent's soul into a close web that checks every movement.

name: Taut Parry
description: Parry a soul-strike with a taut cord and turn it aside.

name: Plaited Lash
description: Lash a plaited cord across an opponent's soul so that the blow lands in several strands at once.

name: Plaited Net
description: Drop a plaited net over a cluster of souls so that each is held where it stands.

name: Cordage Collapse
description: Close the net all at once so that every soul within it takes a sudden crushing squeeze.

name: Rising Lash
description: Whip a lash upward against an opponent's soul so that it cracks across the guard.

name: Lofted Tie
description: Tie a line to a high point and pull up to it in one light step.

name: Lash Screen
description: Whirl a lash before the user so that it forms a screen against a thin soul-bolt.

name: Higher Reading
description: Read the souls above and beyond through a lash held aloft.

name: Whipcord Lash
description: Crack a whipcord lash at an opponent's soul so that it stings sharply and clings.

name: Drawn Aloft
description: Catch a leaping soul with a lash and draw it aloft off its line.

name: Lashing Veil
description: Spin lashes into a veil that sheds soul-bolts from above.

name: Skyward Snare
description: Hang a snare high over a spot so that it drops on the first hostile soul that rises through it.

name: Hanging Lash
description: Leave a lash hanging from an opponent's soul that weighs it down and presses down its force.

name: Gale Fetter
description: Throw a fetter on a gust of soul force and close it on an opponent's soul.

name: Whirling Strand
description: Whirl a strand round the user so that a soul-bolt winds off it.

name: Gusting Hitch
description: Hitch to a far soul on a gust and be drawn across in a rush.

name: Rushing Cord
description: Send a cord rushing at an opponent's soul so that it strikes before it is seen.

name: Wind Reading
description: Let the fetter feel the gust of force around a soul and read its direction.

name: Fetter Squall
description: Loose a squall of fetters that tangles an opponent's forming techniques.

name: Streaming Wrap
description: Stream a wrap of fetters round the user that bears a steady press of soul force.

name: Keening Gyve
description: Close a keening gyve on an opponent's soul that sings against its force and presses it down.

name: Gale-Borne Gyves
description: Send a sweep of gyves on the gale that closes on every soul in front of the user.

name: Fetter Tempest
description: Whip the gale of fetters across the field so that each soul it crosses is cinched and thrown.

name: Sworn Knot
description: Tie a knot sworn to a short vow and cinch it on an opponent's soul.

name: Vowed Strand
description: Hold a vowed strand before an ally that keeps a soul-strike from them.

name: Troth Stride
description: Bind a stride to the pledge and cover the distance in the breath of the oath.

name: Whispered Tie
description: Whisper a tie to a soul and feel whether it answers in good faith.

name: Spoken Hasp
description: Speak a short word and let it close a hasp on an opponent's technique for a breath.

name: Pledge Cinch
description: Cinch the pledge on a soul that swore falsely so that its force falls low.

name: Oath Untied
description: Untie a forced vow from an ally's soul and let the ally's own will run free again.

name: Troth Knot
description: Tie a troth knot that holds an opponent to a word and seals the technique that would break it.

name: Oath Fetter
description: Lay an oath fetter on an opponent's soul that seals its techniques while the oath stands.

name: Troth Snare
description: Plant a snare sworn to a boundary so that it closes on any soul that crosses without leave.
